title: Improving regional weather forecasts with neural interpolation
abstract: arXiv:2505.12040v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper we design a neural interpolation operator to improve the boundary data for regional weather models, which is a challenging problem as we are required to map multi-scale dynamics between grid resolutions. In particular, we expose a methodology for approaching the problem through the study of a simplified model, with a view to generalise the results in this work to the dynamical core of regional weather models. Our approach will exploit a combination of techniques from image super-resolution with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and residual networks, in addition to building the flow of atmospheric dynamics into the neural network. We find that building in the flow more than halves the squared error of small networks.

translated_title: 利用神经插值改进区域天气预报
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们设计了一个神经插值算子来改进区域天气模型的边界数据，这是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为我们需要在不同网格分辨率之间映射多尺度动力学。特别地，我们提出了一种通过研究简化模型来处理该问题的方法论，旨在将本工作的结果推广到区域天气模型的动力核心。我们的方法结合了图像超分辨率中的卷积神经网络（CNN）和残差网络等技术，此外还将大气动力学的流动构建到神经网络中。我们发现，将流动嵌入网络后，小型网络的平方误差减少了一半以上。
tldr: 本文设计了一个融合图像超分辨率技术、卷积神经网络、残差网络以及大气动力学流动的神经插值算子来改进区域天气模型的边界数据，其中嵌入动力学流动使小型网络的平方误差减少一半以上。
en_tdlr: This paper designs a neural interpolation operator combining image super-resolution techniques, CNNs, residual networks, and embedded atmospheric dynamics flow to improve boundary data for regional weather models, with the embedded flow more than halving the squared error of small networks.
